1. **UnaryOptions Pattern:** Options that should only affect unary calls are wrapped in UnaryOption functions and appended to o.UnaryOptions slice
2. **StreamOptions Pattern:** Streaming-specific options use StreamOption functions appended to o.StreamOptions
